name: Leaderboard
description: Ranked names and scores, sorted highest first, with gold, silver and bronze for the top three; changed scores count up and the order follows.

params.name: rows
params.help: Up to 10 rows: name, score (a number). Sorted by score, highest first; send the whole table on every change

params.name: unit
params.help: Shown after each score, e.g. " pts"
